1.text: Dore hazima umwami utegekesha gukiranuka, kandi abatware be bazatwaza imanza zitabera.

2.text: Umuntu azaba nk'aho kwikinga umuyaga n'ubwugamo bw'umugaru, nk'imigezi y'amazi ahantu humye n'igicucu cy'igitare kinini mu gihugu kirushya.

3.text: Amaso y'abareba ntazagira ibikezikezi, kandi amatwi y'abumva bazayatega.

4.text: Uw'umutima uhutiraho azamenya ubwenge, uw'ururimi rudedemanga azavuga neza byumvikane.

5.text: Umupfapfa bazaba batakimwita imfura, n'umunyabuntu buke bazaba batakimwita umunyabuntu,

6.text: kuko umupfapfa azavuga iby'ubupfapfa, akerekeza umutima ku byo gukiranirwa, kugira ngo akore ibyo gutukisha Imana no kuvuga ibigoramye ku Uwiteka ngo yicishe umushonji inzara, n'ufite inyota atamuramiza amazi.

7.text: Kandi intwaro z'umunyabuntu buke ni mbi, agambanishiriza umugwaneza ibinyoma ngo amurimbure, nubwo uwo mutindi avuga ibitunganye.

8.text: Ariko imfura yigira inama yo kugira ubuntu, kandi izo nama zo kugira ubuntu azazikomeza.

9.text: Mwa bagore bataye umuruho mwe, nimuhaguruke munyumve, mwa bakobwa b'abadabagizi mwe, nimutegere amatwi amagambo yanjye.

10.text: Muzamara iminsi isāze umwaka muhagaritse imitima, mwa bagore b'abadabagizi mwe, kuko umwengo uzabura kandi nta sarura rizabaho.

11.text: Mwa bagore bataye umuruho mwe, nimuhinde imishyitsi, mwa badabagizi mwe, muhagarike imitima, mwiyambure mwambare ubusa mukenyere ibigunira.

12.text: Bazikubita mu bituza bababajwe n'imirima yabanezezaga n'inzabibu zeraga cyane.

13.text: Mu gihugu cy'ubwoko bwanjye hazamera amahwa n'imifatangwe, ndetse bizamera no ku mazu anezeza yose yo mu murwa w'umunezero,

14.text: kuko urugo rw'umwami ruzatabwa, umurwa wari utuwe cyane uzaba amatongo. Umusozi n'umunara w'abarinzi bizaba ubuvumo iteka ryose, bizaba inama y'imparage n'urwuri rw'amashyo

15.text: kugeza aho Umwuka azadusukirwaho avuye hejuru, maze ubutayu bukaba imirima yera cyane, umurima wera bakawita ishyamba.

16.text: Maze urubanza rutabera ruzaba mu butayu, gukiranuka kuzaba mu mirima yera cyane.

17.text: Umurimo wo gukiranuka ni amahoro, kandi ibiva ku gukiranuka ni ihumure n'ibyiringiro bidashidikanywa iteka ryose.

18.text: Abantu banjye bazatura ahantu h'amahoro, babe mu mazu akomeye no mu buruhukiro butuje.

19.text: Ariko ishyamba rizagushwa n'urubura, kandi umurwa uzasenywa rwose.

20.text: Murahirwa mwa babiba mu nkuka z'amazi yose mwe, mukahabwiriza inka n'indogobe.
